data:
@QuasiIso.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {ι : Type u_3} →
  {C : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
      [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_3} ι} →
          {K L : @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c} →
            @Quiver.Hom.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1} (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                  (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                  (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                    (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                    (@HomologicalComplex.instCategory.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)))
                K L →
              [∀ (i : ι), @HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst inst_1 ι c K i] →
                [∀ (i : ι), @HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst inst_1 ι c L i] → Prop

@QuasiIsoAt.{u_1, u_2,
    u_3} : {ι : Type u_3} →
  {C : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
      [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_3} ι} →
          {K L : @HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c} →
            @Quiver.Hom.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1} (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                  (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                  (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{max u_3 u_1, max (max u_2 u_3) u_1}
                    (@HomologicalComplex.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)
                    (@HomologicalComplex.instCategory.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ι C inst inst_1 c)))
                K L →
              (i : ι) →
                [@HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst inst_1 ι c K i] →
                  [@HomologicalComplex.HasHomology.{u_1, u_2, u_3} C inst inst_1 ι c L i] → Prop
